method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across loving another enough to desire their good, mutual prayer and remembrance across distance, the garden imagery of rain, trees, birds and fruit, recognition, knowledge and renewal through revelation, purity, unity and steadfastness in the Covenant, service through education, speech, music, teaching and peace, prayers for children, families and named individuals, refuge, healing and remembrance of the departed, and the closing hope for every good in this world and the next. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. Imported wording checked separately; version differences remain explicit. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: O Lord! Illumine their hearts with the light of Thy knowledge and adorn their temples with the ornament of piety.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s brief prayer that hearts be illumined with knowledge and temples adorned with piety; joins understanding and conduct.

selected.text: O my Lord! Enable Thy servants to turn unto the Tree and its fruits, and the Sun and its lights, and the Sea and its waves.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that His servants turn to the Tree and its fruits, the Sun and its lights and the Sea and its waves; recognition pictured through three images.

selected.text: O Lord! Renew them through Thy Most Exalted Word and illumine their hearts, O Thou Possessor of Names and Creator of heaven!
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s brief prayer that God renew the believers through His Most Exalted Word and illumine their hearts; renewal through revelation.

selected.text: O Lord, assist Thy righteous servants to spread the fragrance of flowers and the morning breeze from the gardens of Thy nearness
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s brief prayer that the righteous spread the fragrance of flowers and the morning breeze from the gardens of nearness; service in the language of the garden.

selected.text: Make their cup to overflow, their star to shine, their morn to dawn, their horizon to gleam, their sea to surge and their lamp to blaze!
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s succinct series asking that their cup overflow, their star shine, their morn dawn and their lamp blaze; a memorable compression of the guide’s imagery.

selected.text: O handmaiden of God! I beseech God that thou mayest remain firm and steadfast in faith and certitude, and arise to serve the Kingdom of God.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s brief prayer that a handmaiden remain firm in faith and certitude and arise to serve; steadfastness joined to service.

selected.text: O my loving Lord! Grant life to these lonely ones and lead them to the Beloved. Free them from prison and bring them into the heavenly court.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that lonely ones be given life, freed from prison and brought into the heavenly court; prayer for the lonely and confined.

selected.text: O Lord! Assist this exalted Branch of the Tree of Thy mercy to remain firm and steadfast, and all who are related to Him in this mighty Covenant
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that an exalted Branch of the Tree of mercy and all related to Him in the Covenant remain firm; keeps the specific Covenant setting of this section.

selected.text: O Lord! Withhold not Thy servants from the splendors of the Day-Star of Thy Manifestation, and disappoint them not of the outpourings of Thy days.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that His servants not be withheld from the splendors of the Day-Star of His Manifestation; recognition of the Manifestation as the good sought.

selected.text: O Lord! Make easy, through Thy bounty and grace, all that which is difficult, and answer, through Thy favor, bounty and generosity, all who supplicate Thee
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that God make easy all that is difficult and answer all who supplicate; the closing confidence in an answering God.

selected.text: O Thou kind Lord! These are Thy servants who have gathered in this meeting, have turned unto Thy Kingdom and are in need of Thy bestowal and blessing
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Make his relatives noble ones, his in-laws righteous ones, and all those connected to him free ones. Aid them through Your grace evening and morn
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a man’s relatives be noble, his in-laws righteous and all connected to him free; prayer extending through kinship.

selected.text: O Thou kind Lord! Through the power of Thy Faith and Thy Covenant bestow with every breath a new life and spirit upon this tender and conscientious youth
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a tender, conscientious youth receive with every breath a new life and spirit; prayer for a young person.

selected.text: O God! O God! Verily I place my head on the earth and beg of Thee, O Thou Lord of lords to submerge these believers of Thine in the river of the Water of Life!
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer, head on the earth, that believers be submerged in the river of the Water of Life; a vivid closing image of renewal.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Lord of the Day of Mutual Separation, to assist Thy servants and handmaidens to be steadfast in Thy love and to be detached from all else but Thee.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that His servants and handmaidens be steadfast in His love and detached from all else; steadfastness and detachment.

selected.text: Send down, O God, upon all who have believed in Thee and Thy signs, every good thing which Thy knowledge hath encompassed and which Thou hast sent down in the Tablet.
selected.reason: The Báb’s prayer that God send down upon all believers every good thing His knowledge has encompassed; the Báb’s voice in the closing wish.

selected.text: Ordain for him every good thing in the Kingdom of Mysteries, gather him with the righteous ones, and protect him from the calamities of night and the predators of day.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a person be gathered with the righteous and protected from the calamities of night and predators of day; protection pictured vividly.

selected.text: O Lord! Expand their breasts, illumine their hearts and give rest to their spirits through Thy copious, abundant outpourings upon the kingdom of the heavens and earth.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s brief prayer that God expand their breasts, illumine their hearts and give rest to their spirits; a compact statement of inward relief and light.

selected.text: O Lord! Be generous unto him with eloquent speech, with an expansive heart, and with a radiant countenance through the light of Your knowledge, O Merciful, O Compassionate One!
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s brief prayer that a person be given eloquent speech, an expansive heart and a radiant countenance; capacities for teaching.

selected.text: We beseech Him to water through thee the earth and all that is therein, that there may grow from it the herbs of wisdom and utterance and the hyacinths of knowledge and understanding
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that through a believer God water the earth so herbs of wisdom and hyacinths of knowledge grow; one person as a channel of growth for others.

selected.text: Supplications and entreaties were made at the Threshold of Oneness that whatever is your ultimate desire may be fulfilled and facilitated, and that your power of memory may progress
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s supplication that a correspondent’s ultimate desire be fulfilled and their power of memory progress; a distinctive concrete request within spiritual hopes.

selected.text: Therefore we must pray for each other, implore and supplicate, and show forth utter helplessness and restlessness until the Most Merciful makes manifest that which befits this name
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s counsel that we must pray for each other with utter helplessness until the Most Merciful manifests what befits the correspondent’s name; the guide’s statement of mutual prayer.

selected.text: to rain down, out of the heaven of Thy mercy and the clouds of Thy tender compassion, what will gladden the hearts of Thy servants, who have turned towards Thee and helped Thy Cause
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I continually make entreaty and supplication at the Divine Threshold that He may make our dear fellow countrymen perfect in all human virtues and the cause of educating the ignorant.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that His fellow countrymen become perfect in human virtues and the cause of educating the ignorant; links virtue and education.

selected.text: Therefore, I supplicated and implored the Heavenly Father on your behalf and sought infinite confirmations, that you might become the cause of firmness and steadfastness for others.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s supplication that a correspondent become the cause of firmness and steadfastness for others; one person’s growth serving others’ steadfastness.

selected.text: I have prayed for his praiseworthy progress, that he may plant in the world of existence a sapling which, nourished by the dewdrops of grace, may grow and yield goodly fruit forever.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a person plant a sapling in the world that grows and yields goodly fruit forever; progress pictured as lasting fruit.

selected.text: We beseech God, exalted be He, to assist thee, honor thee, bestow upon thee, and give thee to drink from the Kawthar of life and whatsoever is befitting this blessed and wondrous Day.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that a believer be honored and given to drink from the Kawthar of life; a personal blessing.

selected.text: O my God! Aid Thy loved ones to remember and praise Thee, then inspire them with that which shall subdue the hearts of Thy creatures and the souls of them that dwell in Thy dominion.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the loved ones be inspired with what will subdue the hearts of His creatures; the inward power of praise.

selected.text: O my Lord and my Hope! I beseech Thee … to aid Thy servants in every direction, to quicken their hearts through Thy divine breathings, to revive their souls through Thy gentle breezes
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that God aid His servants in every direction and quicken their hearts with His breathings; renewal for all.

selected.text: I beseech God that He may accept her prayer and facilitate the fulfillment of her hopes, and that He may comfort her eyes through witnessing your success and prosperity in the Kingdom
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a mother’s hopes be fulfilled and her eyes comforted by her child’s success in the Kingdom; a parent’s hope answered through a child.

selected.text: Make these stars radiant, and these lamps brilliant with endless light. Teach these birds the Pahlavi song, and grant these winged ones the power of flight in the heaven of detachment.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the stars be radiant and the birds be taught the Pahlavi song and given flight in the heaven of detachment; a distinctive image of song and freedom.

selected.text: Whenever I hear that such a soul is found, I praise the Blessed Beauty for His favor and bounty and beg Him to encircle him with the angels of protection and the seraphs of preservation.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s words that when He hears of such a soul He asks that angels of protection encircle him; protection for a person of worth.

selected.text: O Lord! Quicken their hearts with the breathings of Thy holiness, and expand their breasts with the signs of Thy oneness, and perfume their nostrils with the sweet fragrance of Thy favors.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that hearts be quickened, breasts expanded and nostrils perfumed with His favors; a concise prayer of renewal.

selected.text: that the kind Lord may bestow greatness upon His friends and grant them success - that is, may He give them sovereignty in the world of the spirit and bestow joy in the realm of the Kingdom
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá explaining that the greatness and success He seeks for the friends means sovereignty in the world of the spirit and joy in the Kingdom; clarifies what spiritual success means.

selected.text: O Lord! These are birds soaring in recognition - implant in their wings the brilliant signs of might and power that they may fly to the highest summit, the ultimate goal, an infinite space.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that birds soaring in recognition receive signs of power in their wings to fly to an infinite space; the wing image for spiritual ascent.

selected.text: from the time your name was mentioned and your trace became known, I have beseeched God that you might become a sign of divine knowledge and a manifestation of the bounty of the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s assurance that from the first mention of a name He has prayed the person may become a sign of divine knowledge; remembrance of someone known only from afar.

selected.text: O God! Assist this servant to promote Thy mighty Cause and to spread the sweet fragrance of Thy wondrous remembrance and to raise high Thy lofty standard and to reveal Thy ancient mystery
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a servant promote the Cause, spread God’s remembrance and reveal His ancient mystery; a concise statement of teaching service.

selected.text: I have always been occupied with thoughts of you and have constantly beseeched God that you may be honored in servitude at the divine threshold and shine like a lamp in the gathering of friends
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s assurance of constant prayer that a friend be honored in servitude and shine like a lamp among the friends; personal remembrance across distance.

selected.text: Thee, O my God! Verily, this Thy servant and this Thy maidservant have gathered under the shadow of Thy mercy and they are united through Thy favor and generosity. O Lord! Assist them in this Thy world and Thy kingdom and destine for them every good through Thy bounty and grace
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: My Lord! Grant them success to walk the most straight path and deliver them from the severest perils. Grant them a true mention throughout ages and cycles and a widespread fame among the servants.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the friends walk the straight path, be delivered from perils and be truly remembered through the ages; protection and lasting mention.

selected.text: Then I beseech Thee, O Thou Goal of the world and Beloved of the nations, to open before my face and the faces of them that love Thee the gates of Thy grace, Thy mercy, Thy favor and Thy blessing.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the gates of grace, mercy and blessing open before Him and all who love God; shared hope for a whole company.

selected.text: When I saw that likeness, I supplicated and implored, at the Threshold of the Lord of the Kingdom, to make thee a dear one of the two realms and to free thee from every fetter save the love of God.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying, on seeing a person’s likeness, that they be freed from every fetter save the love of God; remembrance prompted by a likeness.

selected.text: O Lord! Raise from those sanctified souls the cry of 'Holy and Sanctified!' and adorn those abstract forms with the robe of Thy greatest gift. Make eyes seeing, ears hearing, and tongues speaking.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that God make eyes seeing, ears hearing and tongues speaking; a compact image of awakened perception.

selected.text: Through the favors of the Glorious Lord, it is hoped that those left behind by that pearl will be nurtured in the shell of God's infinite bounties and become manifestations of favors and bestowals.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s hope that those left behind by a departed soul be nurtured in the shell of God’s bounties; the bereaved family pictured as pearls.

selected.text: The hope is that those two beloved friends may become exemplars for the people of prostration, and day by day witness evident confirmations, that they may guide the heedless to the praised station.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s hope that two beloved friends become exemplars and guide the heedless; prayer for a pair of friends.

selected.text: Verily, I beg of God to bestow upon thee and thy relatives the blessing of His clemency and to assign for thee and for them everlasting glory and eternal life in the visible world and in the Kingdom.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a correspondent and his relatives receive God’s clemency and eternal life; prayer for an extended family.

selected.text: O Lord! The night of deprivation hath descended upon all creation, so cause the lights of the Sun of Reality to shine upon all beings until the morn of certitude breatheth with the light of knowledge
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the Sun of Reality shine on all beings in the night of deprivation until the morn of certitude dawns; prayer for the awakening of all creation.

selected.text: O Generous One! Guide the heedless to the ocean of awareness, illumine Thy handmaidens with the light of Thy Name, and assist them to perform pure and holy deeds and to acquire praiseworthy character.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the heedless be guided to awareness and the handmaidens assisted to perform holy deeds and acquire praiseworthy character; joins awareness to conduct.

selected.text: I will pray for him and beseech the Lord of the Kingdom that he may become a valiant soldier of the Lord of Hosts and break asunder the ranks and multitudes of the heedless through the power of proof
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a man become a valiant soldier of the Lord of Hosts who breaks the ranks of the heedless through proof; service as persuasion by proof.

selected.text: I am praying every night and I supplicate and implore. I beg of God to bestow upon you infinite grace so that all of us may attain to the station of servitude, so that we may do as He wishes us to do.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s words to Anna Kunz that He prays every night that all may attain the station of servitude; nightly intercession in His own spoken words.

selected.text: O thou who art perfumed by the breaths of God's love! … I have read thy letter and have supplicated unto God that He may accept thee into His Kingdom, make thee worthy to be called a child of the Kingdom
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a correspondent be accepted into the Kingdom and made worthy to be called a child of the Kingdom; a distinctive formulation of spiritual identity.

selected.text: O Lord, grant this poor one a place in the exalted court, make him esteemed, make him a shining star in the heaven of forgiveness, and bestow upon him shelter and refuge in the shade of the tree of hope.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a poor one be esteemed and sheltered in the shade of the tree of hope; dignity for the poor.

selected.text: God willing, may his blessed son Mirza Habib follow in his footsteps and associate with the people with his character and nature, and may that handmaiden of God become the manifestation of abundant favors.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s hope that Mirza Habib follow his father’s footsteps in character; inheritance of character within a family.

selected.text: Then send down upon the hearts of Thy loved ones that which will purify them from all else but Thee and cause them to speak Thy praise, that Thy remembrance may be spread through them amongst Thy servants.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the loved ones be purified and speak His praise so that His remembrance spreads among His servants; purification for the sake of others.

selected.text: We beseech the favors of the Lord of all desire that He may quicken the handmaidens of God in that land through the life-giving breeze of His grace and enable them to achieve that which befits this century.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the handmaidens of a land be quickened and achieve what befits this century; prayer for the women of a region.

selected.text: O Lord! Deliver them from the evil of the people of error, immerse them in the sea of supplication and entreaty, and make them fountains of guidance, lamps in the darkest night, brilliant and luminous stars
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that God deliver them from the people of error and make them fountains of guidance and lamps in the darkest night; protection and light.

selected.text: We beseech God, exalted be He, to ordain for you that which will bring joy to your eyes and gladden your hearts and expand your breasts, and to aid you in that which will benefit yourselves and your brethren
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that God aid the believers in what will benefit both themselves and their brethren; joins one’s own good to the good of others.

selected.text: O 'Ata'u'llah! Thou art in the House while the Wronged One remembereth thee in His Most Great Prison and prayeth God to ordain for thee that which beseemeth the heaven of His grace and the sun of His bounty.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh remembering ‘Ata’u’llah from the Most Great Prison and praying God ordain for him what beseems His grace; intercession from prison to a named believer.

selected.text: Do Thou inspire Thy loved ones to preserve, as they would their own eyes, the fruits of the paradise of Thy oneness, the depths of Thy unity, the ocean of Thy singleness, and the seas of Thy grandeur's might
selected.reason: The Báb’s prayer that the loved ones preserve as their own eyes the fruits of the paradise of God’s oneness; carries the recognition theme to the guarding of what is received.

selected.text: Lord, Lord! Make his illustrious descendant follow in his footsteps, chanting his prayers, reciting his words, so that he may be his hidden secret, his evident successor, his glorious light, his mighty proof
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that an illustrious believer’s descendant follow in his footsteps and become his evident successor; the inheritance of service.

selected.text: O Lord! Make them fresh and verdant, flourishing through the outpourings of the clouds of Thy mercy, stirred by the breezes of Thy love, growing and thriving through the heat of the Sun of Truth in Thy Kingdom
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the friends grow fresh and verdant through clouds of mercy, breezes of love and the heat of the Sun of Truth; names the elements that make growth possible.

selected.text: At all times I beseech and implore from the heaven of the Lord of the Worlds' grace that He may increase their fire of love and illumine the hearts of all with the light of knowledge and whatever is befitting.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that God increase their fire of love and illumine the hearts of all with the light of knowledge; love and knowledge sought together.

selected.text: And We beseech the Lord of Creation to wrap you both in the mantle of righteousness and to make you and them that have believed standards of guidance amidst all creation. Verily, He is powerful over all things.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that two believers be wrapped in righteousness and made standards of guidance; righteousness for a pair.

selected.text: Send, then, Thy blessings, O God, upon the hearts of those who have ascended unto Thee, and upon their spirits, their souls, and their bodies, with all Thy bounty and Thy mercy, and all Thy grace
selected.reason: The Báb’s prayer for blessings upon the hearts, spirits, souls and bodies of those who have ascended; the guide’s distinct prayer for the departed.

selected.text: We beseech God to make him successful in all conditions in that which He loveth and is pleased with … We beseech Him to ordain for His loved ones that which will bring joy to their eyes and gladness to their hearts
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that a believer succeed in what God loves and that the loved ones’ eyes be gladdened; joy for others.

selected.text: Night and day I pray and seek divine confirmations and heavenly assistance for you, that you may all become celestial and that the lights of the Abha Kingdom may illumine your soul and heart, even your very being.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s night-and-day prayer that the friends become celestial and the lights of the Abhá Kingdom illumine their very being; a concise statement of hoped-for transformation.

selected.text: O my Lord! Assist them to serve Thy servants and aid them to win Thy good-pleasure and exalt them in the Kingdom of existence and illumine them with the lights of Thy bounty in the worlds of the Unseen and the Seen.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the friends be assisted to serve God’s servants and be illumined in the seen and unseen worlds; opens the section on service.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest Thy sincere servants who have entered the stronghold of Thy Cause and clung to the hem of Thy bounty. I implore Thee to shield them from the evil of Thy servants and the oppression of Thy creatures
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that sincere servants be shielded from the evil and oppression of others; protection for the vulnerable.

selected.text: one who remembers thee at the Sacred Threshold, who prays for thy success, who seeks divine confirmation for thee, who causes the clouds of bounty to rain upon thee, who draws forth for thee the breast of God's mercy
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s portrait of a friend who remembers another at the Sacred Threshold and draws down bounty for them; makes intercession across distance tangible.

selected.text: I pray to God that thou mayest employ this talent in prayer and supplication, in order that the souls may become quickened, the hearts may become attracted and all may become inflamed with the fire of the love of God!
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the recipient employ this talent in prayer and supplication so that souls are quickened and hearts attracted; a talent offered for others’ spiritual life.

selected.text: Have mercy upon Thy servant who hath taken refuge at the gate of Thy oneness, who hath sought shelter at the threshold of Thy grace, who hath clung to the cord of Thy favors, who hath held fast to the hem of Thy bounty
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer for mercy on a servant who has sought shelter and clung to the hem of God’s bounty; a plea for mercy on another.

selected.text: Make the handmaiden of God Tuba radiant and cause her to soar in the infinite heights. Make her the intimate companion of the birds of that boundless space and harmonize her with the birds of the garden of immortality
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the handmaiden Tuba soar in the infinite heights among the birds of the garden of immortality; prayer for a named woman.

selected.text: Verily, I beseech my Lord to grant thee thy greatest wishes and to bestow on thee the privilege of entering into the center of the Kingdom of God; and to make thee a herald in His name, in that vast and extensive region
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a correspondent receive her greatest wishes and become a herald in His name in a vast region; service across distance.

selected.text: Verily I pray to God to make thee and thy revered husband--under the shadow of His Greatest Name--confirmed in all conditions, aided in the service of the Cause of God with a confirmation on the part of the Merciful Lord.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a woman and her husband be confirmed in all conditions and aided in service; prayer for a married couple.

selected.text: My Lord! My Lord! We are indeed lowly ones - exalt us through Thy power and assist us through the confirmations of Thy most glorious Kingdom. Dilate our breasts through the verses of Thy holiness, O my Most Exalted Lord!
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the lowly be exalted and assisted by the confirmations of the Kingdom; strength sought in lowliness.

selected.text: O Lord! Grant Thy maidservants the power of discrimination and make Thy handmaidens the dawning-places of the signs of sanctification. Make their hearts intimate with Thy love and their spirits familiar with Thy bounty
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the maidservants receive the power of discrimination and become dawning-places of sanctification; discernment and holiness.

selected.text: My God, my God! Perfume the hearts of Thy loved ones with the outpouring rain of Thy bounties, make their lives pleasant through the sprinklings of the cloud of Thy mercy, and make them signs of guidance among all peoples.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the rain of bounties perfume the hearts of the loved ones and make them signs of guidance among all peoples; nourishment leading to guidance of others.

selected.text: O Lord! This is a servant who has been set aflame by the fire of Thy love … Protect him within the protection of Thy safekeeping from the arrows of tribulation and guard him beneath the glances of Thy protection and favors
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a servant set aflame by love be protected from the arrows of tribulation; protection for an individual.

selected.text: O maid-servant of God! I hope through the Grace and Bounty of the Creator that the lights of guidance may shine upon the members of the household (family) and that they may receive a portion from the bounty of the Kingdom.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s hope that the lights of guidance shine on the members of a household; prayer for a whole family.

selected.text: O Thou kind God, suffer this maidservant of the threshold to become heavenly, angelic, merciful and celestial. Confer Thy providence upon her, reveal to her Thy mercy, Thy clemency, and aid her in the service of the Kingdom.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a maidservant become heavenly, angelic and merciful and be aided in the service of the Kingdom; character joined to service.

selected.text: O Educator of existence! These souls are prostrate in worship and in utmost supplication before the Kingdom of the visible world. Therefore, the hope of this servant at Your threshold is that You be their shelter and refuge.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s hope that God be shelter and refuge for souls prostrate in supplication; refuge as the closing petition of the difficulty section.

selected.text: My God, my God! Aid Thy loved ones to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee, to serve Thy Cause and to stand firm in their love for Thee. Adorn their deeds with the glory of Thy acceptance and the light of Thy good-pleasure.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the loved ones serve the Cause, stand firm in love and have their deeds adorned with His acceptance; service and acceptance.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to send down from the heaven of Thy loving-kindness upon Thy loved ones that which will renew them in Thy love, cause them to speak Thy praise, and preserve them from whatsoever is repugnant to Thy good-pleasure
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that God send down what will renew the loved ones in His love and preserve them from what He dislikes; renewal and protection.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to rain down upon him who hath turned unto Thee the showers of Thy mercy from the clouds of Thy grace. O Lord! Assist him through Thy bounty and ordain for him that which befitteth the heaven of Thy generosity
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the showers of mercy rain upon one who has turned to God; individual blessing in the closing section.

selected.text: O Thou Beloved of the horizons! This yearning servant, descendant of the illustrious 'Abdu'llah, seeketh Thy good-pleasure. May he remain protected and preserved in the shelter of Thy protection from the winds of tests and trials.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a descendant of the illustrious ‘Abdu’llah remain protected from the winds of tests and trials; protection for a named lineage.

selected.text: Through the boundless grace and favor, I beseech for you heavenly blessings and seek the nurturing of the vernal rain. I seek the radiance of the Sun of Truth and yearn for the life-giving breeze from the direction of divine favor.

selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a woman be taught the mysteries of the Kingdom and her tongue loosened so others’ hearts are revived; learning in order to give.

selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that a devoted servant’s highest wish be granted and he become a sign of mercy among all people; prayer for a particular person.

selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the friends become stars of guidance and meteors against the satans of self and passion; the inward struggle named.

selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s invocation of God Who shone from Sinai, Seir and Paran, asking Him to look upon the pure ones with mercy; sets prayer for others within the history of revelation.
